title: I've Got a Love Song in My Heart
lyrics: Verse 1:
[Bsus2]I've got a love song in my [E]heart,
(I've got a love song in my [F#]heart)
It is for You, Lord, my [Bsus2]God.
(It is for You, Lord, my God)
[Bsus2]I've got a love song in my [E]heart,
(I've got a love song in my [F#]heart)
[Bsus2]It is for You, Lord, my God.
(It is for You, Lord, my God)
Verse 2:
I've got a passion in my heart,
(I've got a passion in my heart)
It is for You, Lord, my God.
(It is for You, Lord, my God)
I've got a passion in my heart,
(I've got a passion in my heart)
It is for You, Lord, my God.
(It is for You, Lord, my God)
Chorus 1:
[Bsus2]La la la la la la [E]la, La la la la la la [F#]la
[Bsus2]La la la la la la la x2
Verse 3:
I've got rejoicing in my heart,
(I've got rejoicing in my heart)
It is for You, Lord, my God.
(It is for You, Lord, my God) x2
Verse 4:
And there is dancing in my heart, (And there is dancing in my heart)
It is for You, Lord, my God.
(It is for You, Lord, my God) x2
Verse 5:
I've never known a love like this,
(I've never known a love like this)
I've never known a love like this.
(I've never known a love like this) x2
